query.statement: SELECT UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WHERE UI_ID = @uiId
SELECT UI_ID, TITLE FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION ORDER BY UI_ID

INSERT INTO SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION (UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@uiId, @title, @definitionJson, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(UI_ID) DO UPDATE SET TITLE = excluded.TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON = excluded.DEFINITION_JSON, UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ROLE_ID
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_ID = @roleId AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, PROGRAM_ID, IMAGE_ID, OPTIONS, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, MENU_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, ROLE_ID, LANGUAGE, IS_ACTIVE, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM SYS_USER WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@roleId IS NULL OR ROLE_ID = @roleId) ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_ID

SELECT F.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.PROGRAM_ID, M.IMAGE_ID, M.UI_ID, F.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU F JOIN SYS_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = F.MENU_ID AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' WHERE F.USER_ID = @currentUser ORDER BY F.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, F.MENU_ID

INSERT INTO SYS_FAVORITE_MENU (USER_ID, MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, CREATED_AT) SELECT @currentUser, M.MENU_ID, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(F.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE) FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU F WHERE F.USER_ID = @currentUser), 0) + 1, @utcNow FROM SYS_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID = @menuId AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU F2 WHERE F2.USER_ID = @currentUser AND F2.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID)
DELETE FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId
UPDATE SYS_FAVORITE_MENU SET DISPLAY_SEQUENCE = @sequence WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId

SELECT R.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.PROGRAM_ID, M.IMAGE_ID, M.UI_ID, R.LAST_USED_AT FROM SYS_RECENT_MENU R JOIN SYS_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = R.MENU_ID AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' WHERE R.USER_ID = @currentUser ORDER BY R.LAST_USED_AT DESC LIMIT 10

INSERT INTO SYS_RECENT_MENU (USER_ID, MENU_ID, LAST_USED_AT) SELECT @currentUser, M.MENU_ID, @utcNow FROM SYS_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID = @menuId AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' ON CONFLICT(USER_ID, MENU_ID) DO UPDATE SET LAST_USED_AT = excluded.LAST_USED_AT
DELETE FROM SYS_RECENT_MENU WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID NOT IN ( SELECT MENU_ID FROM SYS_RECENT_MENU WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser ORDER BY LAST_USED_AT DESC LIMIT 10)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM WHERE CLEARED_AT IS NULL) AS ACTIVE_ALARMS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WHERE STATUS IN ('Issued','InProgress')) AS OPEN_WORK_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WHERE STATUS IN ('Released','InProgress')) AS ACTIVE_PLANS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RMS_RECIPE WHERE APPROVAL_STATE IN ('WaitApproval','Approved1')) AS PENDING_RECIPE_APPROVALS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ORDER WHERE STATUS IN ('Draft','Confirmed')) AS OPEN_DELIVERY_ORDERS

SELECT BATCH_ID, BATCH_NAME, BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_RULE, BATCH_OPTIONS, BATCH_INPUTDATA, AUTO_TRANSACTION, SAVE_HISTORY, DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM SYS_BATCH_PROCESS WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY BATCH_NAME, BATCH_ID

INSERT INTO SYS_BATCH_PROCESS (BATCH_ID, BATCH_NAME, BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_RULE, BATCH_OPTIONS, BATCH_INPUTDATA, DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@batchId, @batchName, @batchType, @batchRule, @batchOptions, @batchInputData, @description, 'Valid', @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow) ON CONFLICT(BATCH_ID) DO UPDATE SET BATCH_NAME = excluded.BATCH_NAME, BATCH_TYPE = excluded.BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_RULE = excluded.BATCH_RULE, BATCH_OPTIONS = excluded.BATCH_OPTIONS, BATCH_INPUTDATA = excluded.BATCH_INPUTDATA, DESCRIPTION = excluded.DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE = 'Valid', UPDATED_BY = excluded.UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT = excluded.UPDATED_AT
UPDATE SYS_BATCH_PROCESS SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE BATCH_ID = @batchId

INSERT INTO SYS_BATCH_PROCESS_HISTORY (HISTORY_ID, BATCH_ID, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, SUCCESS, AFFECTED, ERROR_MESSAGE, EXECUTED_BY) VALUES (@historyId, @batchId, @startedAt, @finishedAt, @success, @affected, @errorMessage, @currentUser)

SELECT HISTORY_ID, BATCH_ID, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, SUCCESS, AFFECTED, ERROR_MESSAGE, EXECUTED_BY FROM SYS_BATCH_PROCESS_HISTORY WHERE (@batchId IS NULL OR BATCH_ID = @batchId) ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT NAME, SAVED_AT, VALUES_JSON FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId ORDER BY SAVED_AT DESC

INSERT INTO SYS_CONDITION_SETTING (USER_ID, MENU_ID, NAME, SAVED_AT, VALUES_JSON) VALUES (@currentUser, @menuId, @name, @utcNow, @valuesJson) ON CONFLICT(USER_ID, MENU_ID, NAME) DO UPDATE SET SAVED_AT = excluded.SAVED_AT, VALUES_JSON = excluded.VALUES_JSON
DELETE FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId AND NAME = @name

DELETE FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId AND NAME <> '$latest' AND NAME NOT IN ( SELECT NAME FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId AND NAME <> '$latest' ORDER BY SAVED_AT DESC LIMIT 10)

INSERT INTO SYS_MENU (MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID, VALID_STATE) VALUES (@menuId, @menuName, @parentMenuId, @displaySequence, @menuType, @uiId, 'Valid') ON CONFLICT(MENU_ID) DO UPDATE SET MENU_NAME = excluded.MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID = excluded.PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE = excluded.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE = excluded.MENU_TYPE, UI_ID = excluded.UI_ID, VALID_STATE = 'Valid'
UPDATE SYS_MENU SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid' WHERE MENU_ID = @menuId
SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, NOTICE_TYPE, POSTED_BY, POSTED_AT, IS_ACTIVE FROM SYS_NOTICE ORDER BY POSTED_AT DESC
SELECT MSG_CLASS_ID, MSG_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM SYS_MESSAGE_CLASS ORDER BY MSG_CLASS_NAME
SELECT MSG_ID, MSG_CLASS_ID, MSG_CODE, MSG_TEXT, LANGUAGE FROM SYS_MESSAGE WHERE (@msgClassId IS NULL OR MSG_CLASS_ID = @msgClassId) ORDER BY MSG_CODE
SELECT LANG_CLASS_ID, LANG_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM SYS_LANGUAGE_CLASS ORDER BY LANG_CLASS_NAME
SELECT I18N_ID, LANG_CLASS_ID, MESSAGE_KEY, LANGUAGE, TRANSLATION FROM SYS_I18N ORDER BY MESSAGE_KEY
SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, RULE_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE, DESCRIPTION FROM SYS_RULE ORDER BY RULE_NAME
SELECT FILE_ID, VERSION, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, DESCRIPTION, FORCE_UPDATE, IS_ACTIVE, UPLOADED_BY, UPLOADED_AT FROM SYS_DEPLOY_FILE ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC

SELECT LOG_ID, METHOD, PATH, STATUS_CODE, ELAPSED_MS, USER_ID, CLIENT_IP, REQUESTED_AT FROM SYS_REQUEST_LOG WHERE (@method IS NULL OR METHOD = @method) AND (@userId IS NULL OR USER_ID = @userId) ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT LOG_ID, LOG_LEVEL, CATEGORY, MESSAGE, EXCEPTION, LOGGED_AT FROM SYS_APP_LOG WHERE (@logLevel IS NULL OR LOG_LEVEL = @logLevel) ORDER BY LOGGED_AT DESC LIMIT 500
